# plancap

**plancap** estimates the floorspace and dwellings that planning rules
enable on each land parcel, for any jurisdiction, and summarises,
compares and plots the result.

Planning rules (height limits, setbacks, recession or daylight planes,
site coverage, landscaping, floor area ratios, density controls,
overlays and precincts) are entered as a **rulebook**: a validated set
of rules with a citation for every value, written in R, as a YAML file,
or in an Excel template. Capacity is built site by site as a stack of
storey footprints clipped by every rule that applies, then summarised by
zone, height, location or the rule that binds. Plan changes are compared
as scenarios, with the change split into what drove it.

## From parcels to results

``` r

library(plancap)
town <- exampleton()

sc <- scenario("Operative", rulebook_example("exampleton"),
               parcels = town$parcels[town$parcels$parcel_type == "land", ],
               roads = town$parcels[town$parcels$parcel_type == "road", ],
               zoning = town$zoning, layers = town[c("height_areas", "transit")])
cap <- estimate_capacity(sc)

summary(cap)                          # headline, by zone, what limits dwellings
check_capacity(cap)                   # reconciliation: parcels, land, storeys
summarise_capacity(cap, by = c("zone", "height_band"))
plot_capacity(cap)                    # floor area by zone
plot_constraints(cap)                 # from the theoretical maximum to enabled
explain_site(cap, "P00001")           # every setback at every storey, with citations
```

A plan change is a scenario that states only what differs:

``` r

pc1 <- exampleton_pc1()
change <- scenario_change(sc, "PC1", rulebook = pc1$rulebook, zoning = pc1$zoning)
cmp <- compare_scenarios(run_scenarios(scenario_set(sc, change)))
plot_attribution(cmp)                 # rules, zoning, overlays, parcels
```

## What it covers

- **Rules**: yards, recession and daylight planes (graded by
  orientation, turning vertical, measured from the far side of a road),
  upper-level and height-proportional setbacks, any setback profile,
  alternative standards, coverage, landscaping, impervious area, floor
  area ratio, floorplate and tower limits, building length and
  separation, the site shape factor, density, access width, height
  overlays and surfaces, exclusions, precincts with dwelling totals,
  bonuses and entitlements; any value may be a formula.
- **Sites**: road, side and rear boundaries, corner, through and rear
  sites, access legs and rights of way, the zone across each boundary,
  water boundaries, sloping ground; every assumption adjustable.
- **Summaries and plots**: one
  [`summarise_capacity()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/summarise_capacity.md)
  for every breakdown, a constraint waterfall, sensitivity sweeps, maps,
  a 3D view, and comparison plots, in one quiet, colour-blind-safe
  theme.
- **Verified**: it reproduces the capacityengine model exactly on an
  Auckland tile, including the effect of Plan Change 120.

## Rulebooks that ship

``` r

rulebook_examples()
#> "auckland" "christchurch" "exampleton" "exampleton_pc1" "hamilton" "wellington"
```

Exampleton and its plan change are fictional. Auckland, Christchurch,
Wellington and Hamilton are dated worked examples: check the plan before
relying on any value. The vignette *Adding a new jurisdiction: Hamilton*
enters a real plan through the Excel template, from the plan text to
results.

## Scope

plancap estimates **plan-enabled, gross, blank-slate** capacity: what
the rules would allow on each site if no buildings existed. It does not
estimate feasible, infrastructure-ready or likely development. See
*Method and assumptions*.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("faceteconomics/plancap")
```

## Licence

MIT © James Stewart. Exampleton is synthetic. Rulebooks transcribe
public district plans and cite each rule.

# Package index

## Rulebooks

A rulebook holds every planning rule for one plan, with a citation for
every value. Build one in R, or read it from YAML, JSON or a
spreadsheet.

- [`rulebook()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/rulebook.md)
  : Create a rulebook
- [`add_zone()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/add_rules.md)
  [`add_overlay()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/add_rules.md)
  [`add_area()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/add_rules.md)
  [`add_bonus()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/add_rules.md)
  [`add_entitlement()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/add_rules.md)
  [`add_unmodelled()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/add_rules.md)
  : Add rules to a rulebook
- [`set_zone_map()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/set_rules.md)
  [`set_zone_families()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/set_rules.md)
  [`set_defaults()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/set_rules.md)
  [`set_morphology()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/set_rules.md)
  [`set_conversion()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/set_rules.md)
  [`set_ground()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/set_rules.md)
  [`set_variant_choice()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/set_rules.md)
  : Set rulebook-wide settings
- [`zone_family()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/zone_family.md)
  : A zone family that depends on the size of the land across a boundary
- [`read_rulebook()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/read_rulebook.md)
  [`write_rulebook()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/read_rulebook.md)
  : Read and write rulebooks
- [`rulebook_template()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/rulebook_template.md)
  : Rulebooks as spreadsheets
- [`rulebook_example()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/rulebook_example.md)
  [`rulebook_examples()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/rulebook_example.md)
  [`rulebook_example_path()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/rulebook_example.md)
  : Rulebooks shipped with plancap

## Zones

The rules a zone applies to every site in it.

- [`zone()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/zone.md)
  [`zone_changes()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/zone.md)
  : Define a zone
- [`height_limit()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/height_limit.md)
  : Height limit
- [`ratio()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/ratio.md)
  : A share of site area
- [`bands()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/bands.md)
  [`band_value()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/bands.md)
  : Banded values and ratios
- [`building_form()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/building_form.md)
  : Building form limits
- [`density()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/density.md)
  : Density rules
- [`use_mix()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/use_mix.md)
  : Uses a zone enables

## Setbacks

Yards, recession and daylight planes, upper-level and
height-proportional setbacks: every rule that keeps a building back from
a boundary.

- [`yard()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/yard.md)
  [`plane()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/yard.md)
  [`upper_level_setback()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/yard.md)
  [`proportional_setback()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/yard.md)
  [`setback_profile()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/yard.md)
  : Setback rules: yards, planes and everything that keeps a building
  back
- [`setback_distance()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/setback_distance.md)
  : Required setback distance at a height
- [`conditions()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/conditions.md)
  : Conditions under which a rule applies
- [`boundary_classes()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/boundary_classes.md)
  : Boundary classes

## Overlays, areas, bonuses and entitlements

- [`overlay()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/overlay.md)
  : Overlays: spatial layers that change the rules
- [`area()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/area.md)
  : Areas: precincts, sub-precincts and site-specific controls
- [`sub_area()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/sub_area.md)
  : A sub-area of an area
- [`bonus()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/bonus.md)
  [`entitlement()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/bonus.md)
  : Bonuses and entitlements
- [`unmodelled_rule()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/unmodelled_rule.md)
  : Record a rule that is not modelled

## Checking and changing rulebooks

- [`validate_rulebook()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/validate_rulebook.md)
  : Check a rulebook
- [`rule_table()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/rule_table.md)
  : Every rule in a rulebook as one table
- [`set_rule()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/set_rule.md)
  [`extend_rulebook()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/set_rule.md)
  : Change rules for a what-if or a scenario
- [`convert_rulebook_units()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/convert_rulebook_units.md)
  : Convert a rulebook between metres and feet
- [`rulebook_schema_path()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/rulebook_schema_path.md)
  : Path to the rulebook JSON Schema

## Scenarios and site preparation

A scenario is a rulebook with its parcels and maps. Preparing it turns
parcels into sites with classified boundaries, ready for the engine;
prepared steps are reused across scenarios that share their inputs.

- [`scenario()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/scenario.md)
  [`scenario_change()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/scenario.md)
  : Scenarios: a rulebook with its maps and parcels
- [`prepare_sites()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/prepare_sites.md)
  : Prepare sites for a scenario
- [`clear_site_cache()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/clear_site_cache.md)
  : Clear plancap's cache of prepared sites

## The building envelope

Each site’s stack of storey footprints, clipped by every rule that
applies at each height and capped by site ratios.

- [`build_envelopes()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/build_envelopes.md)
  : Build the storey-by-storey building envelope of every site

## Capacity

Floor area and dwellings, by the path each zone’s method sets.

- [`estimate_capacity()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/estimate_capacity.md)
  : Estimate plan-enabled capacity
- [`site_shape_factor()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/site_shape_factor.md)
  : The site shape factor: can a site hold the plan's rectangle?

## Comparing scenarios

Plan changes as scenarios: run a set incrementally, compare each with
the baseline (by site, zone transition, area and height), split the
change into its drivers, and check that it all adds up.

- [`scenario_set()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/scenario_set.md)
  [`run_scenarios()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/scenario_set.md)
  : Sets of scenarios, run together
- [`read_scenarios()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/read_scenarios.md)
  : Read a set of scenarios from a manifest file
- [`compare_scenarios()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/compare_scenarios.md)
  [`summary(`*`<plancap_comparison>`*`)`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/compare_scenarios.md)
  : Compare scenarios: what changed, where, and why
- [`diff_inputs()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/diff_inputs.md)
  : What differs between two scenarios' inputs
- [`check_comparison()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/check_comparison.md)
  : Reconcile a comparison

## Summaries and checks

Capacity by zone, height, site size, location or binding constraint; the
floor area each kind of rule removes; one site explained; a rule swept
through values; reconciliation; the register of rules not modelled.

- [`summarise_capacity()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/summarise_capacity.md)
  [`default_measures()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/summarise_capacity.md)
  : Summarise capacity by zone, height, size, location or binding
  constraint
- [`summary(`*`<plancap_capacity>`*`)`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/summary.plancap_capacity.md)
  : Summarise a capacity result
- [`capacity_table()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/capacity_table.md)
  : A formatted capacity table
- [`constraint_breakdown()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/constraint_breakdown.md)
  : Floor area lost to each kind of rule
- [`explain_site()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/explain_site.md)
  : Explain one site's capacity
- [`sensitivity()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/sensitivity.md)
  : Sweep a rule through a set of values
- [`check_capacity()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/check_capacity.md)
  : Reconciliation and diagnostics for a capacity result
- [`unmodelled_report()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/unmodelled_report.md)
  : The register of rules not modelled

## Plots

Every plot returns a ggplot object with one quiet theme, a validated
colour-blind-safe palette in light and dark, and a caption stating what
the figures are.

- [`plot_capacity()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/plot_capacity.md)
  [`plot_height_profile()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/plot_capacity.md)
  [`plot_distribution()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/plot_capacity.md)
  [`plot_constraints()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/plot_capacity.md)
  [`plot_capacity_map()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/plot_capacity.md)
  [`plot_cumulative()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/plot_capacity.md)
  : Plot capacity
- [`plot_comparison()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/plot_comparison.md)
  [`plot_change_map()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/plot_comparison.md)
  [`plot_transitions()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/plot_comparison.md)
  [`plot_attribution()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/plot_comparison.md)
  : Plot a scenario comparison
- [`plot_sensitivity()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/plot_sensitivity.md)
  : Plot a rule sweep
- [`plot_site()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/plot_site.md)
  : Plot one site's envelope
- [`autoplot(`*`<plancap_capacity>`*`)`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/autoplot.plancap_capacity.md)
  : A capacity dashboard
- [`view_capacity_3d()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/view_capacity_3d.md)
  : A 3D view of capacity
- [`theme_capacity()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/theme_capacity.md)
  [`scale_fill_capacity_d()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/theme_capacity.md)
  [`scale_colour_capacity_d()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/theme_capacity.md)
  [`scale_fill_capacity_c()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/theme_capacity.md)
  [`scale_fill_capacity_div()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/theme_capacity.md)
  : The plancap plot theme and colour scales
- [`capacity_palette()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/capacity_palette.md)
  : Colours of the plancap palette

## Site and boundary types

Road frontages, side and rear boundaries, corner, through and rear
sites, access legs, water boundaries and road widths, each with the
evidence for the call; the access width of rear sites; the front
setbacks of the dwellings along a street.

- [`find_road_frontages()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/morphology.md)
  [`find_side_rear()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/morphology.md)
  [`find_corner_sites()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/morphology.md)
  [`find_through_sites()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/morphology.md)
  [`find_rear_sites()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/morphology.md)
  [`find_access_legs()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/morphology.md)
  [`find_water_boundaries()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/morphology.md)
  [`find_road_widths()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/morphology.md)
  [`site_metrics()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/morphology.md)
  : Identify what each boundary and site is
- [`find_access_widths()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/find_access_widths.md)
  : Measure the legal access to rear sites
- [`find_existing_front_setbacks()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/find_existing_front_setbacks.md)
  : The existing front setback of the dwellings along a street
- [`check_morphology()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/check_morphology.md)
  [`plot_morphology()`](https://faceteconomics.github.io/plancap/reference/check_morphology.md)
  : Check and draw how sites and boundaries were classified
